method: 4-RGDD of type 3^8: points Z_7 x 3 rows + 3 fixed, groups {(x,0),(x,1),(x,2)} and {inf0,inf1,inf2} form the 3-way week, one base 4-way class developed mod 7 (cyclic.py, base class from seed 7 of the convsearch.gen template); lane pairs by z3 with at most K bowlers off (lanes017k.py), positions by de Werra colouring (tools/positions.py). Exact lanes are impossible (a lane pair gets 3 + 4x visits, never 24), so at least 2 bowlers are off
